mission.goal: Build a proof-gated local performance-control foundation for chat and agent workstreams.
mission.workflow: audit -> benchmark -> snapshot -> ledger -> capsule -> canary -> proof
mission.data: Canonical JSON packets and SQLite receipts; no secrets persisted.
mission.environment: Local reversible runtime; provider integration excluded.
mission.governance: Formation-gated A0/A1 scope with proof-state separation.
mission.failure: Fail closed on invalid input, stale snapshots, fence conflicts, proof loss, stream risk and missing metrics.
mission.testing: Unit, integration and CLI smoke tests with failure-first cases.
mission.deployment: No deployment in this mission; deploy command is an explicit no-op boundary.
mission.continuity: SQLite checkpoints, deterministic digests, handoff files and stop switch.

assumptions.runtime: Single local process with SQLite locking; multi-host deployment requires an external durable database/runtime.
assumptions.authentication: Snapshot HMAC key supplied via environment; no provider authentication
assumptions.deployment: Out of scope until separate owner authorization and provider-native canary

components.queue: Generation/slot receipt identity and controller lifecycle
components.scheduler: External scheduler adapter boundary; none created
components.cache: Stable context capsule and source-epoch digest
components.authentication: HMAC producer signature with environment-provided key

observability.correlation_ids: mission_id, snapshot_id, task_id, generation and slot
observability.health_checks: CLI smoke plus ledger-chain and snapshot verification
observability.metrics_alerts: Canary duration/call ratios, proof parity, invariant failures and harm signals

testing.e2e_or_smoke: CLI stream, benchmark and canary examples
testing.fixtures_mocks: Temporary SQLite databases and deterministic JSON fixtures
testing.failure_first: Tamper, stale, overflow, duplicate, fence, proof-loss, harm and missing-state tests

delivery.file_tree: README, contract, governance/memory/handoff, src package, tests, examples and docs
deploy_commands: NO_DEPLOYMENT_AUTHORIZED: integrate only after a fresh Formation permit and provider canary
rollback_commands: Remove the not-yet-integrated package or restore the prior adapter; preserve ledger evidence
delivery.debugging: Run one failing test, inspect JSON issue codes and verify ledger chain; do not retry unchanged provider routes.

watchman.rollback: Local artifact is removable; provider state remains untouched.

continuity.checkpoints: Signed snapshots and hash-chained SQLite head
continuity.resume_conditions: Valid signature, freshness, coverage, generation and ledger fence
continuity.stop_switch: Caller stops on any HOLD/REJECT/QUARANTINE or user supersession

proof.test_results: 47/47 unit tests PASS; compileall PASS; stream, benchmark and synthetic canary CLI smoke paths PASS on 2026-09-04.
proof.semantic_verification: Tamper/stale/coverage/generation snapshot rejection, fenced idempotent ledger and chain verification, byte-budget capsule, strict five-phase canary, evidence-state score split and stream quarantine were exercised. Synthetic fixture results do not establish provider performance.
